narration: Work Orders is the CMMS at the heart of FactoryLM — every job tracked from open to done.
Filter across all, open, in progress, and completed. Four are open right now on the Stardust Racers, tagged high and medium priority.
Each order carries its ID, status, assignee, and due date — and because it's wired to MIRA, the diagnosis and the fix travel with it.
